question: Two points P and Q are maintained at potentials of $10$ V and $-10$ V respectively. If a positive charge is released from rest at P, what will be its subsequent motion?

options.B: It will move towards Q with increasing kinetic energy.
options.C: It will move towards Q with constant velocity.
options.D: It will move away from Q.
